rule: Block drop table, drop column, data loss, and unreviewed object removal in release preview.
enforcement_point: sqlpackage deploy report and script review
rollback_boundary: restore point or backup boundary only

rule: Compare deployed database to the committed dacpac before publish.
failure_action: stop release until drift is classified

rule: Reference data deployments must be idempotent and natural-key based.
rollback_boundary: manual data repair script if partial execution occurs

rule: Security changes require explicit role/grant traceability.
Production publish requires main branch, approved environment, release evidence, and no failed gates.
One dacpac release is the rollback unit; data migrations use separate reviewed scripts.
rollback_boundary: roll forward preferred after schema publish
